name: Delta Electronics Company of LA, Inc.
old_description: Our company was founded in 1967 and has since evolved into a family of professionals dedicated to offering the Greater New Orleans area a place to purchase electronic components, accessories, and 12 volt electronics while offering installation services. At Delta Electronics, we strive to make every single purchase you make a seamless process from start to finish. Take a look at our site, and feel free to get in touch with any questions or concerns.
about:
Delta Electronics Company of LA, Inc. was founded in 1967 in Harvey, Louisiana. The business describes itself as a family of professionals dedicated to supplying electronic components, accessories, and 12-volt electronics to the Greater New Orleans area.

The company operates as a distributor and installer, stocking hundreds of products from brands such as ACR Electronics, Victron Energy, and RIGID Industries. Its product range includes fuses, relays, switches, wire terminals, marine electronics, semiconductors, and various cables and connectors. In addition to sales, Delta Electronics provides installation services for GPS tracking, car audio, window tinting, backup cameras, law enforcement electronics, trailer lighting, and CB radio systems.

Customers include commercial wholesale buyers, government and municipal agencies, and retail consumers across the marine, automotive, and law enforcement sectors. The company offers a business account program that provides contract pricing after an application review of one to two business days.

Delta Electronics emphasizes a seamless purchasing experience from start to finish, combining a physical storefront with an online catalog and a service bay for professional installations.
